scope: primary-literature audit of dimension-free robust unilocal broadcasting to EB reconstruction

opportunities.candidate_interface: For rho_AB with I(A:B)_rho<=C and a local CPTP Gamma_{B->B1B2} such that both joint states (id_A tensor Gamma)(rho_AB)_{ABj} are within half trace b of rho_AB, find one EB Lambda_{B->B} with half trace reconstruction error g(C,b)->0 uniformly over local dimensions.
opportunities.closest_exact_antecedent: Piani arXiv:1501.06855v1 Eq. (4): a channel with a k-output extension supported on the fully symmetric subspace is within d_B/k in half-trace diamond distance of an EB channel. Piani Theorem 1 also transfers its fixed-state fidelity to EB fidelity with penalty sqrt(2 d_B/k).
why_it_does_not_close: The candidate supplies only two approximate marginals on one input state, not a many-output fully Bose-symmetric channel extension.
The known finite-de-Finetti penalty depends on d_B/k and is not dimension-free at k=2.
Fawzi-Renner recovers a state from small conditional mutual information but the recovery channel need not be EB.
Known discord continuity bounds depend on a local dimension or require convergence of mutual-information values; I(A:B)<=C alone is not stated as the needed uniform trace-continuity hypothesis.
opportunities.decisive_missing_mechanism: A dimension-free stability theorem for the exact one-sided no-local-broadcasting characterization, converting a channel-generated two-output approximate broadcast of one state under I(A:B)<=C into one EB reconstruction of that same state in joint half trace distance.
opportunities.literature_verdict: No exact theorem or counterexample matching the candidate was identified in this bounded primary-source pass. This is not a novelty or priority claim; candidate validity remains a proof question.
